page.opens: A finished example reel plays: the voice, the word-by-word caption with its boxed key word, and the real things drawn under it.
page.asks: Keep the house look and voice, or make it yours: the caption, the background, the voice, the words, a reference to copy.
page.rule: The motion, the visuals and the method are the format; they are not setup questions. A draft is not a saved preference. Never repeat setup for a new reel.
page.writes: The full-visual-customization skill saves the choices in workspace/library/full-visual/profile.json and workspace/library/full-visual.preferences.md, after a short test render the buyer accepted.

questions.ask: Is there a creator or a reel you want this to look or sound like?
questions.changes: Read by the agent and mapped onto the caption, ground and voice fields; anything the engine cannot do is named, not faked.

questions.ask: Keep this caption or change its font, size, colours, key word marker or position?
questions.default: the house caption: Figtree 74 px, white active word, grey said words, blue selection box

questions.ask: Dark or light background, and with or without the faint grid?
Which voice service, and which voice?
questions.changes: reel.json voice, or a voice.json for OpenAI or Fish Audio; the voice is picked by ear from short auditions

questions.ask: Should the format write the script, or will you bring your own transcript?
questions.changes: Which source stage 1 starts from; the comment keyword and the post caption shape

questions.ask: What do you want your reels to be about, and which creators do you learn from?
questions.changes: The research lanes and stance read before every reel

example: Render about nine seconds of an example reel with the chosen look into workspace/output/<date>-full-visual-look-test/look-test.mp4, beside the house look.
